hero.title: What if your tool evolved with you, without overloading you with useless features?
hero.subtitle: Stop wasting time looking for a tool built for solo users, minimalist by default, that cleans your workspace on its own: NuxiPro does the essentials and simplifies your daily life.

pourquoi.label: Why I built this software
pourquoi.p1: I was using proprietary solutions I couldn't audit, and they didn't solve my problem: my workspace was becoming a graveyard of completed tasks.
pourquoi.p2: I tried todo lists and kanbans: they share one thing in common, tasks stay visible even when they're done. I tried Todoist but it didn't move tasks to a dedicated archive space, so they reloaded in the background every time I opened the page, which hurt performance.
pourquoi.p3: So I decided to build this minimalist tool, deliberately limited to the essentials, sovereign and respectful of your privacy. It's also open source: you'll never be locked into the software, your data is yours and you can migrate to a VPS or dedicated server to self-host with peace of mind.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: NuxiPro is a minimalist personal task manager that automatically cleans your Kanban board by archiving completed tasks.
faq.q2: Is NuxiPro built for team collaboration?
faq.a2: No team features for now. NuxiPro stays solo-first: personal productivity without team overhead, notifications, or clutter. Team remains a possible optional upgrade later — only once solo is fully ready, not before, and only if you want to evolve.
faq.q3: How does automatic task archiving work?
faq.a3: The demo archives tasks instantly when moved to Done — data stays in your browser only. In the cloud version, you simply choose your archiving mode at sign-up: instant archiving or archiving after X days.
faq.q4: Can I test NuxiPro right now?
faq.a4: Yes, you can try the free interactive demo directly at demo.nuxipro.com without creating an account.
faq.q5: How can I access the full version of NuxiPro?
faq.a5: The full version (app.nuxipro.com) is currently in development and not accessible yet. You can join the waitlist to get early access at launch.
faq.q6: Can I still find my tasks once they are archived?
faq.a6: Yes, all archived tasks are safely stored and remain accessible at any time in your dedicated archive area.
faq.q7: Is the cloud version of NuxiPro minimalist?
faq.a7: Yes. I use NuxiPro Cloud for my own projects, so I keep only the essentials: solo-first by default, no team overhead, no Jira-like onboarding with endless fields. You learn it once by using it. Team features may come later, strictly optional — only once solo is fully ready, never required upfront.
faq.a8:
No.

The current demo at demo.nuxipro.com is not open source and is time-limited: it will be stopped.

It will be replaced by an open-source, very simplified Cloud-based demo without account (browser-limited, time-limited storage) only after NuxiPro Cloud is ready — not before, to avoid wasting time on a demo while Cloud is not ready.

This is planned, no date promised.

Don't use the current demo for real work: data stays in your browser and can be lost.
faq.q9: Is NuxiPro open source and self-hostable?
faq.a9: Yes. NuxiPro Cloud is open source (AGPLv3) on Codeberg and self-hostable, but not production-ready: still in development.
faq.q10: Where is NuxiPro hosted and is it GDPR-compliant?
faq.a10:
NuxiPro Cloud is hosted in Finland (UpCloud, Europe) and your data stays in Europe.

GDPR roadmap: legal hub, documented sub-processors, consent traceability.

Honest black spots (Cloud version only, not your data): frontend + DNS on Cloudflare (US company) and monitoring via OpenObserve (US company even with EU servers).

Planned: migrate DNS + frontend away from Cloudflare and self-host OpenObserve in my own infra for full sovereignty when means allow — for now, I stay on their managed services.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: How I collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.intro: NuxiPro respects your privacy. This policy explains how I handle data for both the landing page and the demo version.

landingPage.title: 1. Landing Page
landingPage.intro: I do not collect any direct personal data. Only strictly necessary analytics data is collected to improve the service, provide a better user experience and understand friction or drop-off points.

tools.title: Tools and data collected
tools.text: I use two complementary tools to understand visits on the landing page: Cloudflare Web Analytics (anonymous, always on) and PostHog (detailed journey analysis, only with your consent).

anonymous.title: Anonymous visit counts
anonymous.text: Cloudflare Web Analytics counts page views in aggregate. It sets no cookies, stores no IP addresses, and cannot identify visitors. As no personal data is collected, no consent is required.

survol.title: Hover and interactions
survol.text: Page sections viewed by the user.

conversion.title: Conversion
conversion.text: Clicks on call-to-action (CTA) buttons to measure page effectiveness.

recording.title: Session Recording
recording.text: Subject to your explicit consent. All captured data is fully anonymized and configured in maximum privacy mode in PostHog: IP addresses are discarded at project level and never stored, and displayed or entered texts are automatically masked (replaced with “****”). Stored 30 days max by PostHog, I can delete them beforehand to keep only useful sessions for project improvement. No data is ever sold or shared with third parties.

protection.title: Protection and control of session recordings
protection.text: Session recording is strictly framed at application level and in PostHog settings. It is disabled by default to leave you the ultimate choice. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time.

cookies.title: Cookie usage
cookies.text: Opt-in analytics (PostHog) use cookies only with your explicit consent. Separately, anonymous audience measurement (Cloudflare Web Analytics) runs without cookies and without storing IP addresses, so it requires no consent.

demo.title: 2. Interactive Demo of NuxiPro
demo.intro: The demo version of NuxiPro runs entirely client-side (local) within your browser.

local.title: Exclusively local storage
local.text: All data generated in the demo is stored exclusively in your device's local storage (LocalStorage). No data is transmitted, processed or saved on a remote server.

loss.title: Permanent loss upon clearing
loss.text: If you clear your browsing data (cache clear or LocalStorage deletion), all demo data will be permanently and irreversibly lost, with no possibility of recovery.

experimental.title: Experimental use
experimental.text: The demo is an experimental tool designed solely to let you discover the concept and basic features of NuxiPro.

professional.title: Professional use discouraged
professional.text: Using this demo in a professional or daily context is strictly discouraged. As browser-side storage is inherently volatile, never enter critical, confidential or irreplaceable data.

clause.title: Disclaimer clause
clause.text: The demo is provided “as is” for trial purposes. Under no circumstances can the publisher be held liable for any data loss, access interruption or direct or indirect damage related to the use of the demo or non-compliance with the above usage warnings.

noSell.title: I never sell your data
noSell.text: NuxiPro does not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties. The only data collected is anonymous site usage statistics, solely to improve the product.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. Since all data is stored locally in your browser, you can clear it at any time through your browser settings.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.desc: Cookies, analytics, and local storage usage policy.
cookies.p1: This policy explains how I use cookies and local storage on NuxiPro.

exempt.title: Audience measurement without cookies
exempt.text: In addition to opt-in analytics, this site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics, enabled via my Cloudflare Pages hosting. It counts page views in aggregate without setting cookies, without storing IP addresses, and without identifying visitors. No consent is required as no personal data is collected.

localStorage.title: localStorage
localStorage.desc: Stores your tasks, preferences, and consent choices directly in your browser. This is essential for the application to function. Data persists until you clear it.

analytics.title: Analytics (PostHog)
analytics.desc: Anonymous usage data to improve the product. Only active if you consent. IP addresses are discarded, no personal data collected.

consent.title: Consent Storage
consent.desc: Remembers your cookie preferences (accepted/declined) and session recording toggle state.

manage.title: Managing Your Preferences
manage.text: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by clicking the settings icon (gear) in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

demo.title: Demo Version Notice
demo.text: The demo version (demo.nuxipro.com) uses only localStorage for all data storage. No server-side cookies are used. Your data stays in your browser only.

cgu.title: Terms of Use

demo.title: Demo Version
